title: Kannastor GR8TR V2 Storage Puck Black Edition 56mm
description:
The Kannastor Storage Puck Black Edition is your perfect storage solution for when you need to take your favourite herbal blend on the go. This new and improved design now has curved edges making it more comfortable to use and also is less intrusive when storing in your pocket.
The interior of this puck has a high end smooth finish unluck cheaper alternatives that have heavy tool marks.
Dimensions – .75″ (H) x 2.125″ (D)
Threaded lid for secure storage
Pairs to 2.2″ Kannastör® grinders V2
Durable food grade aluminum construction
Limited Lifetime Warranty
